Original student/v3 PPO bridges ignore14 exactly; nohistory input-column14 must remainzero, so it also ignores history exactly. Only history training can use14. protocol.acceptance: Unchanged original screen separately for each new arm: >=1% lower penalized lateral RMSE than LQR, same-supervisor student and BOTH constants; all3 student-relative group gains positive; no survival loss; nominal <=1.02LQR; overall heading/rate RMS <=1.05LQR. Endpoints eligible only after exact100k. Report history-vs-nohistory as ablation, not automatically attribute all improvements to history. If both eligible, freeze lower-RMSE endpoint arm, ties prefer nohistory; no per-seed arm mixing.
protocol.confirmation: Keep reserved data unopened on failure. Winner requires a separately frozen corresponding-model realworker timing validation and native confirmation before any deployment/vehicle claim. Native heartbeat failures on current cloud are not fixed by adding a neural input.
protocol.stop: Exactly two prespecified arms x3 finite pilots; no new reward/controller/hyperparameter search after outcomes, no extensions. Publish failures, all seeds, histories and model hashes. Physical/robust-reference requirements remain separate and cannot be fabricated.
